name: sonner
title: Sonner
description: The sonner toaster, themed onto the token contract — an alternative notification engine with its own imperative API.

meta.whenToUse: The same brief notifications as Toast, when a project already speaks sonner's `toast()` API or wants its stacking model.
meta.whenNotToUse: Alongside Toast in the same app — pick one notification engine, or two stacks will fight for the same corner.
